subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should maintainers accept the helper-side process-group leader check after a rebase that preserves current-main MCP close and force-close behavior?
rationale: The patch fixes a real availability bug, but process-tree termination defaults are upgrade-sensitive and the live branch currently conflicts with main, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Rebase and accept
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve newer cleanup paths, rerun focused process tests, and merge the leader-check approach if exact-head validation stays clean.

options.title: Ask for replacement
options.body: If the conflict resolution grows beyond the focused process cleanup surface, close this branch in favor of a fresh narrow PR with the same invariant.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the PR open without merge action until a maintainer with process-runtime context reviews the compatibility tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve newer cleanup paths, rerun focused process tests, and merge the leader-check approach if exact-head validation stays clean.

likelyOwner.reason: They approved and merged the prior related process-tree fix, making them the best available routing signal for this compatibility decision.
